## Landed

**RECIPE-a (§3.9; REQ-XB-201…209):**

- **`scripts/gce-backend.sh`** (bash 3.2) — the single provisioning home; admitted `gcloud` only, no Terraform (ADR-0431). Subcommands: `quote`, `provision`, `verify`, `prepull`, `deliver-secret`, `status`, `harvest`, `teardown`, `inventory`. Missing `gcloud`/`ssh`/`python3`/tar → exit 7 (`require`). `Refused{…}` → 2, `Unsupported{backend.<field>}` → 4, leak-scan hit → 5, inconclusive/h_r → 6.
- **`hh-compute-decl/1`** (`validate_decl.py`) — closed schema: unknown/missing fields refuse; fresh `hh-<phase>-<6hex>` project per phase; STANDARD only; `pd-balanced`; exact image project+name (a `family` refuses); exact pinned package set `{podman, crun, conmon, netavark, compose_frontend}` — a range/`>=` refuses; `service_account: none`; ingress exactly tcp:22 from `35.235.240.0/20` (IAP); `dead_man{max_run_duration_hours=D, action, in_guest_timer=D+15min}`; `restart{max_hours ≤ 1 | preauthorized_hours}`; `disk_floor_gib`; concurrency inputs; `rate_table{path, sha256}`; `mode: full | restart-only`; `h_r_hours ≤ 6`.
- **`hh-compute-receipt/1`** (`validate_receipt.py`) — one receipt per provision/verify/prepull/harvest/teardown: `recorded_at` UTC, ticket/phase/window, recipe path+sha+git-head, declaration path+sha, `authorization{gate, readout_path, verbatim_sha256, quote_id, ceiling_micros}`, verbatim `commands[]` (redacted argv, timestamps, rc, stdout sha256, bounded excerpt), `resources{project, instance, creation_timestamp, deletion_operation_end, disks, external_ipv4}`, `verification`, teardown-only `post_state`, `provided: yes/no` only — never a value. Receipts are leak-scanned before persistence; a hit refuses the write (exit 5). A receipt naming a prior phase's project id refuses.
- **`startup.sh`** — the committed, leak-scanned boot script: `hh` user, rootful podman socket `660 root:hh` (no TCP), pinned `apt-get install` of the declared packages, the in-guest dead-man timer (shutdown at `D+15 min`), tmpfs `/run/hh/secrets`.
- **`provision`** — authorization check (gate, quote_id = the deterministic `pq-<sha>` of the pre-quote, verbatim readout sha, ceiling, model_line) before any create; project create + billing link + services; network + IAP firewall; `instances create` with `--no-service-account --no-scopes --shielded-secure-boot --max-run-duration=<D>s --instance-termination-action`, declared labels, startup + packages metadata. A stopped VM refuses full-mode (`restart_requires:…`).
- **`verify`** — podman `_ping`, pinned versions (podman + dpkg pins for all five packages incl. compose frontend), kernel, vCPUs/mem/disk vs `machine_expect`, socket posture `local_rootful_group_restricted` + zero TCP listeners, the ingress set is *exactly* the IAP rule, no service account, `max_run_duration == D`. Every mismatch is `Unsupported{backend.<field>}`.
- **`prepull`** — only the declaration's admitted images, by digest; receipt records `{task, ref, digest, size_bytes, arch}` + diskwatch `{floor_gib, free_gib, below_floor}`. Refused under restart-only.
- **`deliver-secret`** (§3.11/Q-X17) — the sole Ollama-key path: `HH_OPERATOR_ENV_FILE`, value read at use and streamed over `gcloud compute ssh` stdin into tmpfs `/run/hh/secrets/NAME` (0400, `hh`). Never argv/metadata/startup/disk/receipts — the battery greps the argv log. Refused for a `$0`/unauthorized model window, restart-only, or any name ≠ `OLLAMA_API_KEY`. HF write token never reaches the VM.
- **`harvest`** — remote manifest (`sha256sum` of the run root) + tarball scp'd, local `sha256sum -c` verify, serial + journal + usage captured into `harvest/`, leak-scanned.
- **`teardown`** — the nine steps in F14 order, each recorded in the receipt: (1) drain/`inconclusive{teardown}`; (2) harvest-verify — **delete refuses without it**; (3) serial+usage; (4) every billable class inventoried; (5) delete; (6) re-inventory — empty, `inconclusive{cls}` on WARNING/failure (exit 6, never "empty"), or the *only* admitted deviation: stopped instance + retained disk under a declared dated `DF-*` row inside `h_r`; a RUNNING survivor always refuses; (7) phase-close `projects delete` → `DELETE_REQUESTED` required; (8) kill local helpers; (9) teardown receipt with `post_state`, lifecycle timestamps (REQ-XB-215), settlement clock (`last_model_call_utc_hour` — the REQ-XC-127 boundary), `h_r{declared, elapsed, exceeded, requires_dated_df_row}`, `cost_record: n/a{compute_cost_record: R6.14}`.
- **`quote`** — `pre-quote` label, declaration quantities + §3.10 symbols (`N, s, t_p, t_b, C, H_o, E_gib{estimated}, D, h_r, H_rs`), `pricing: n/a{compute_pricing: R6.14}` — zero network calls (battery asserts the argv log stays empty).
- **`restart-only` mode (Q-X60)** — `instances start` on a declared stopped VM, ≤ 1 h, harvest-and-teardown only: `prepull` + `deliver-secret` refuse, no slot admission.
- **`compute-open.sh`** (REQ-XB-211) — read-only open-compute index: provision receipts with no matching teardown; empty output required for phase/round closure.
- **`compute-gate-span.sh`** (REQ-XH-009) — a window whose provision→teardown span crosses a gate's wait fails unless the readout records `vm_stays_up:`; a gate after teardown does not constrain.
- **`hh-runner::diskwatch`** + `tests/r6_13.rs` (REQ-XB-207) — `admit(free, floor)`: stop below the declared 20 GiB default (inclusive boundary); `prune_set`: only settled tasks' derived layers — shared/`task:None` and in-flight layers never pruned.

**RECIPE-b (REQ-XB-223):**

- **`check-gce-backend.sh`** — a fake `gcloud`/`ssh` shim on PATH: argv → a log, canned JSON → a state dir, `live/` resources mutate the way GCE's would (create/delete/list/describe transitions, `after_delete_*` mutations, `fail/`+`warn/` injection). **79/79**: quote pre-quote/no-network; missing-gcloud→7; 12 declaration refusals; provision argv pins (no-SA, no-scopes, secure-boot, `--max-run-duration=D`, IAP rule); receipt validation + rule set; wrong quote_id/ceiling/absent auth; every `Unsupported{backend.*}` verify field (podman/compose/socket/ingress/max-run); prepull digest/size/arch; restart-only refusals + `instances start`-only; secret over stdin, never argv, $0/restart-only/wrong-name refusals; stopped-VM full-mode refusal; teardown ordering (inventory < delete < re-inventory < project delete < describe); harvest-required-before-delete; leftover-disk/RUNNING/inconclusive-warning exits; stopped-disk DF-row deviation admitted; h_r exceeded → exit 6 + `requires_dated_df_row`; phase-close `DELETE_REQUESTED`; prior-phase project id refuses; **seeded secret in receipt → write refused (5)**; compute-open open→empty; gate-span ×3; `rg gcloud scripts/` single home; leak sweep clean; no secret literals. Fully offline, deterministic, no credential/provisioning/spend.

## Deviations

- **Changed source/test lines > the split trigger** — recorded (the recipe + battery concentrate in three files; a partial tree would strand the validators the battery exercises).
- **Bash subshell-state bug class fixed in review** — `gdo` calls inside `$( )` lose globals → file-based status plumbing; also `printf … | python3 -I - <<'PY'` reads the heredoc as the *program* (stdin empty) → data passed via a temp-file arg instead. Recorded as the kind of bug the battery exists to catch.
- **Receipt timestamps admit fractional seconds** — GCE emits `…T20:00:00.000Z`; the validator's UTC regex accepts the optional `.NNN`.
- **`Unsupported` rc** — verify-time backend mismatches exit 4 (not the `Refused` 2); `cmd_fwrule` carries an explicit `rc=4`.
- **`--max-run-duration=<D>s`** uses `=` form (argv-loggable as one token).
- **Fixture declaration paths** (`rate_table.path`, `readout_path`) point off `docs/` in the battery's embedded decl — they are synthetic strings, and the real committed example keeps `docs/build/…` paths.
